response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, with a strong focus on geospatial applications through GISCollective. However, his primary expertise lies in Node.js, TypeScript, and Dlang, with limited direct experience in modern C++ or Rust, which are critical for this role. His background in routing/navigation systems is minimal, though his geospatial work is relevant. His problem-solving approach and willingness to expand expertise are positive indicators.
strengths: Strong background in geospatial data platforms (GISCollective) with open-source contributions
Experience with real-time systems and high-performance databases (Dunnhumby)
Proven ability to build scalable systems and automate workflows (Optilyz, re:cinq)
concerns: Limited direct experience with modern C++ or Rust, which are primary technologies for this role
No clear evidence of working with navigation/routing systems or geospatial routing pipelines
Most recent roles focus heavily on web/mobile development rather than low-latency, distributed routing data pipelines
